evidence.velocity_vs_rigour: This work isn't for everyone. If you work fast, flexibly, and collaboratively — without compromising standards — we want to hear from you.
evidence.velocity_vs_rigour_explanation: JD explicitly names working fast and a fast-paced startup environment as core values, with testing/documentation present but secondary, so velocity.
evidence.domain_risk: transform raw data into meaningful insights that empower marketing, operations, and decision-making teams
evidence.domain_risk_explanation: Errors affect marketing/operations decision-making at a consumer wireless carrier without explicit regulatory or financial-reporting consequence, so moderate.
evidence.collaboration_width: engineering teams; marketing, operations, and decision-making teams; business stakeholders
evidence.data_team_maturity: Demonstrate expertise in the analytics engineering development cycle, including data modeling, version control, documentation, testing, and ensuring codebase best practices
evidence.data_team_maturity_explanation: Named tools (dbt, Airflow, Redshift, Snowflake, BigQuery, Tableau, Looker) appear in responsibilities with an established development cycle and codebase practices, indicating a mid-maturity data function.
evidence.jd_authorship: Create and optimize data models and schemas to support self-serve analytics and ensure data integrity
evidence.jd_authorship_explanation: Specific tools and precise application context (S3, Redshift, Snowflake, BigQuery, Airflow, dbt) make responsibilities clearly hiring-manager-authored.
evidence.stakeholder_orientation: transform raw data into meaningful insights that empower marketing, operations, and decision-making teams
evidence.stakeholder_orientation_explanation: JD names marketing (commercial) and operations/decision-making teams as roughly equal-weight audiences with no single dominant one, so mixed.
evidence.autonomy_level: Work closely with engineering teams to design and develop data structures that enable deeper analysis
evidence.autonomy_level_explanation: Role collaborates closely with engineering and business stakeholders to build data structures and dashboards rather than independently setting strategic direction.
evidence.ai_role_explanation: The only AI mention in the JD concerns the company's use of AI tools in its own hiring/application-review process, not a skill expected of the candidate in the role.
evidence.testing_framing: Demonstrate expertise in the analytics engineering development cycle, including data modeling, version control, documentation, testing, and ensuring codebase best practices
evidence.testing_framing_explanation: Testing is listed as one of several development-cycle skill areas expected of the candidate rather than framed as an owned quality practice with a dedicated ownership verb, so tool_listed.
evidence.loss_aversion_framing_explanation: JD is framed entirely in delivery, speed, and capability terms ('work fast', 'iterative technical solutions') with no risk or compliance register.
evidence.greenfield_vs_fix: design, develop, and refine data pipelines to transform raw data into meaningful insights
evidence.greenfield_vs_fix_explanation: JD mixes designing new data structures/pipelines with refining and optimizing existing ones, so mixed.
